title: Blackeye Pea Fritter Frenzy
description: A Southern-inspired twist on classic fritters, using blackeye peas for a boost of protein and fiber.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, cheese, egg, buttermilk, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Gently fold in the cooked blackeye peas.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture into balls.
Flatten each ball slightly into a disk shape.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When oil is hot, add a few fritters to the skillet (do not overcrowd).
Fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Transfer fritters to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
